scope: Phone modules that the 7.3 module set deliberately omits or renames, with reasons

sdhci_msm.reason: AVR sdhci@8804000 (only SDHC) is status=disabled in the phone DT; the 7.3 in-tree sdhci-msm imports the upstream 7.3 qcom_ice API, which cannot coexist with the vendor ICE (ports/qcom-ice) that UFS FBE uses (same symbol names, different ABI)

debug_symbol.reason: debug_symbol_available()/debug_symbol_lookup_name() are provided by the 7.3 kernel (kernel/kallsyms.c, core commit 3684f35f1, verified by the debug-symbol suite) from the running symbol table instead of re-decoding the 6.12 debug_kinfo layout

pinctrl-canoe.reason: other-SoC variant loaded on the phone but bound to no device (checked /sys/bus/platform/drivers on the running AVR 6.12 ROM, 2026-11-17); the AVR binds the alor/canoe variant instead, which is ported (pinctrl-alor)

pinctrl-chora.reason: other-SoC variant loaded on the phone but bound to no device (checked /sys/bus/platform/drivers on the running AVR 6.12 ROM, 2026-11-17); the AVR binds the alor/canoe variant instead, which is ported (pinctrl-alor)

ext4_inode_test.reason: GKI KUnit test module (ext4 inode tests), not a device driver

lib_test.reason: GKI test module, not a device driver

clk_scmi.reason: 7.3 in-tree driver replaces the stale vendor copy

rproc_qcom_common.reason: same vendor sources (qcom_common.c + tracepoints); module name to be aligned at packaging

pwrseq_core.reason: 7.3 GKI builds the power-sequencing core in

first_stage_status.note: every phone first-stage module is ported, renamed (renamed{}), or deliberately omitted (omitted{}) with a reason

glink_probe.reason: phone soc:qcom,glink node has no children (edges are remoteproc glink-edge subnodes started by rproc_qcom_common); needs vendor qcom_glink_smem_start/spss APIs - revisit with SPSS

qcom_glink_spss.reason: SPSS (secure processor) edge transport needs vendor qcom_glink_native_start; ported together with qcom_spss

hwmon.config: HWMON (vendor adds devm_hwmon_device_unregister export: add to core if a ported user needs it)

phy_generic.config: NOP_USB_XCEIV (vendor diff: of_property_read_bool vs present only)

i2c_qcom_geni.config: I2C_QCOM_GENI (identical; unbound on the phone, vendor i2c-msm-geni used)
